QuestInfo.name: Ominous Artwork
QuestInfo.1: This is his most recent work, but he's been getting a weird feeling from it. Maybe you should give it a click to investigate.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: Something funky is going on in this gallery and it isn't just Spiegelmann's cologne.

0.0: Oh, this won't do at all! This painting isn't ready for public eyes yet. I suppose there's not much I can do now. I call this piece the 'Dark Gallery'. It was an attempt to capture the essence of the gallery, but it came out... strange.
0.1: I found myself having a rather strange evening on the day I hung it. If you'd like to see for yourself, give it a click. If you have any doubt about your sanity or your strength, I'd advise against it.

1.0: Wasn't that a bizarre experience?! I should be charging for that, but I'll let you off free for being a good test subject.
